text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking along the river…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hah! What say you to that, Digital?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ggnaa, b-beautiful! S-s-sooo sublime!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Greetings, Trainer! Exactly what your eyes bear witness to, of course!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant… I think I'm gonna faint!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Observing the two does little to explain the situation, so I ask for details.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heh… I awaken to a refreshing morning… I am strolling alongside the lovely river…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And lo! What a stunning work of art nature has created this day!
Wooookljh!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was that the wind? An oddly unpleasant sound, if it were.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No matter. First in order is a close-up for my next edition of collectible portraits.
Wh-haaa?! New photos?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: HYEEEEWRE?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And that is what transpired, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Digital was observing me from a concealed spot in the forest. And so, I brought her here to the best seat in the house!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gawww… She's showing mercy. That's a new core memory, straight up.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But hey, Opera O? How'd you even know I was there at all?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nobody gets in the way of my precious Umas pairing up. And to make sure of that, if I have to hide in the ceiling, walls—in this case, trees—I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'd turn into air if I only could. But I didn't mean to be a stone in your way!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Digital, you are no stone. You are… my fan.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Tell me—these ears and hands of mine, what are they for?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: These ears, to hear what my fans desire. These hands, to guide you to the future.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: For the destined-to-be Centurial Overlord, engaging with a fan is no trouble in the least.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hyeeeh! She's got the face and heart of a saint!
choice_data_list: I guess support from your fans can keep you motivated.
So, don't you have some close-ups to take?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come, Digital. I'll show you the strength in my stride.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now with even more splendor, thanks to your enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ooogh, I'll follow you anywhere!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, T.M. Opera O and Agnes Digital run off together, high-pitched giggles and excited chatter echoing in their wake.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of course, realizing their clamor is likely to disturb the surrounding residents, I hastily guide them back to the academy's training track.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's right. Your ability to comprehend situations is effortless and astute. That's why you're my trainer.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, today I will exhibit my certitude… Digital, I shall entrust you with capturing my breathtaking visage!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Y-you… want me to?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Who better than one who has observed my beauty up close?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why, even the spirits who inhabit this very river are enthralled by my appearance. It must be immortalized on film! Now, shoot!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Time to dial my camera skills up to eleven!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As it turns out, Agnes Digital's exceptional photography skills appear authentic. T.M. Opera O praises the "certitude" on display in her resulting photo.
